description: arXiv:2605.05348v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Audio description (AD) narrates visual elements in video for blind and low-vision audiences. Recent work has shown that giving novice describers an AI-generated draft to start from helps produce higher-quality AD and lowers the barrier to entry. What remains an open question is how draft quality shapes the editing process. We investigate...
author: Lana Do, Shasta Ihorn, Charity M. Pitcher-Cooper, Sanjay Mirani, Gio Jung, Hyunjoo Shim, Zhenzhen Qin, Kien T. Nguyen, Vassilis Athitsos, Ilmi Yoon
